crs: EPSG:27700 local metres, x east, z south, y up
source: OS London five-foot plan 1891-96 (cached NLS tiles, layer os-london-five-foot-1893); crane symbols located with the EPFL OS text layer (reference/epfl-london-os-text/londonos_texts_postcorrected.gpkg, labels 'C' / 'c')
method: Every 'C' label inside the core Lower Lea box was checked on a 1 m grid crop of the five-foot mosaic. The OS crane symbol is a dot with a small 'C' beside it; positions are the dot centres, read to about 0.5 m. One label (-1155.8, -73.6) is a letter of larger lettering, not a crane. Cranes in yards whose buildings are not yet modelled are listed under deferred.

form.evidence: Hand-worked iron wharf crane on a timber-capped stone base: post, inclined jib and tie rods, winch at the foot. The OS records position only; the form, size and jib direction are a type-based interpretation for cranes of the period, not evidence about any one crane.
